title: Sunday · the logging road, October
logline: The 2002 cover's road, five years on, in watercolor: the ruts full of sky, the cedars, and above the bend, nothing yet. The strip goes back to look.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the gravel logging road climbing into cedar, October, the ruts full of reflected sky. Where the 2002 cover put a corner box, there is only the road.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a gravel logging road climbing into cedar forest in October with the ruts reflecting a pale sky, no figures, no words
image.notes: The 2002 cover's composition (dw_2002-06-07), without the box.

panels.name: Road

panels.composition: Tier 2: the bend, the trees closing, the light beyond it ordinary.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a bend in a forest road where the trees close in and ordinary daylight shows beyond, no words

panels.name: Bend

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sky above the trees. Gray. Nothing in it. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a strip of gray sky above dark conifer tops with nothing in it, no words
image.notes: Nothing above the bend yet. In 2025 the sequence will walk it.

panels.name: Sky

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The cover's road, revisited. Nothing above the bend yet.
